meaning: to drink tea (also refers to the social custom of gathering to drink tea and chat)

example.hakka: 𠊎兜暗晡頭去飲茶,講一下閒話。
example.romanization: Ngài-têu am-pu-thèu hi yím-chhà, kóng yit-ha hàn-fa.
example.english: We're going to drink tea this evening and chat for a while.

note: 飲 (yím) is the everyday Hakka word for 'drink,' distinct from Mandarin's 喝 (hē) — Hakka closely preserves this older literary Chinese verb. 飲茶 also carries the same cultural sense as in Cantonese, referring to relaxed social tea-drinking, not just the physical act.
